commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseMDSExtract == 1 ]; then
  if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
    $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ac-extract/app-start.sh -e DEV2 -a "-x Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES -t 163000"
  else
    $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ac-extract/app-start.sh -e DEV2 -a "-x Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES -d $BusinessDate -t 163000"
  fi
else
  if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
    AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/cdw/out ac_extract.sh -c Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES_BND,Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES_EQS,Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES_EQI,Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES_FUT -t 163000 -i
  else
    AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/cdw/out ac_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -c Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES_BND,Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES_EQS,Pub_MURX_SCPR_EQS_CB,Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES_EQI,Pub_CDW_SECURITY_PRICES_FUT -t 163000 -i  
  fi
fi
